data.narrative:
MightyFly is a Series A-stage company in the Drones & Autonomous sector, having raised $10M to date. The broader comp universe comprises eight private companies in the sector, including Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, Archer Aviation, and Elroy Air; no public comparables exist in this segment.

Given the early stage and nascent market, a traditional peer-median approach was not applicable. The comp set in Drones & Autonomous contained insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage peers with similar valuation tiers to support reliable multiples-based triangulation. Accordingly, valuation relied on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $10M total raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $20M. This multiplier reflects typical venture capital return expectations at the Series A-to-next-stage transition.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $17M (low) to $23M (median $20M), centered on the stage-progression result. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single methodological input rather than cross-validation across methods. Key uncertainties include MightyFly's specific product maturity, addressable market traction relative to the named peer set, and the applicability of 2.0x stage multipliers to a pre-revenue or early-revenue frontier-tech business. Additional diligence on unit economics and regulatory pathway clarity would strengthen conviction in final pricing.
